system.description:
Make an Interface Roll against a target
within Close range. On a success,
spend a Hope to deploy suppressive
tech around the target that
encompasses everything within Very
Close range of them and follows them
as they move.
The target and everything within the
area is Silenced until the GM spends a
Fear on their turn to clear this
condition, you run Hush Field again, or
you take Major damage.
While Silenced, they can’t make noise
and can’t run comm protocols or use
effects that require audible, verbal, or
broadcast commands.
